name: Samantha Reid, LCSW
bio: Samantha Reid is a Licensed Clinical Social Worker with 18 years of specialized experience in complex trauma, PTSD, and domestic violence recovery. She is a certified Prolonged Exposure (PE) therapist and a Level II EMDR practitioner, trained at the EMDR Institute. She currently leads the Trauma-Informed Care initiative at MindCare and supervises a team of junior clinicians.

name: Daniel Osei, PsyD
bio: Dr. Daniel Osei is a licensed clinical psychologist specializing in substance use disorders, co-occurring mental health conditions, and recovery-oriented systems of care. He holds credentials as a Certified Addictions Counselor (CAC III) and is a master-level trainer in Motivational Interviewing. He facilitates both individual and group DBT-based relapse prevention programs at MindCare.

name: Elena Vasquez, LPC
bio: Elena Vasquez is a Licensed Professional Counselor with a decade of experience providing individual and family therapy to children, adolescents, and young adults experiencing anxiety, depression, and school-related difficulties. She is trained in Trauma-Focused CBT (TF-CBT) and is a registered Play Therapy practitioner. She has a particular clinical focus on the psychological impact of immigration and acculturation on Latinx youth.

name: Marcus Chen, PhD
bio: Dr. Marcus Chen is a licensed clinical psychologist and internationally trained specialist in OCD and obsessive-compulsive spectrum disorders. He completed his doctorate at the University of Washington and a postdoctoral fellowship at the Rogers Behavioral Health OCD program. He is a Fellow of the International OCD Foundation and a certified Exposure and Response Prevention (ERP) therapist.

name: Fatima Al-Hassan, LMFT
bio: Fatima Al-Hassan is a Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist with specialized expertise in Emotionally Focused Therapy (EFT) for couples and multi-generational family systems work. She trained under a certified Gottman Method supervisor and is Level III Gottman certified. She has extensive experience working with intercultural couples, blended families, and communities navigating religious and cultural identity in the context of mental health.

name: Noah Williams, LPCC
bio: Noah Williams is a Licensed Professional Clinical Counselor specializing in affirmative therapy for LGBTQ+ individuals, with particular expertise in gender dysphoria, transgender care, and minority stress. He completed his clinical training at the UCSF Transgender Care Program and is certified in LGBTQ-Affirmative CBT. He is an active community educator on intersectionality, family rejection, and LGBTQ+ youth mental health.

name: Ingrid Holmberg, PsyD
bio: Dr. Ingrid Holmberg is a licensed clinical neuropsychologist with 25 years of experience in comprehensive neuropsychological assessment and cognitive rehabilitation following TBI, stroke, and neurodegenerative disease. She is a Fellow of the National Academy of Neuropsychology (NAN) and holds additional board certification from the American Board of Professional Neuropsychology (ABPN). She developed the MindCare Cognitive Rehabilitation Protocol currently used in six partner hospitals.

name: Tariq Mahmood, LCSW
bio: Tariq Mahmood is a Licensed Clinical Social Worker specializing in grief therapy, bereavement counseling, and end-of-life care support for patients and families. He is certified in Complicated Grief Treatment (CGT) developed at Columbia University and is trained in the Dual Process Model of Coping. He facilitates both individual therapy and peer-led bereavement support groups and has published on culturally responsive grief support in South Asian communities.

name: Renata Kowalski, PhD
bio: Dr. Renata Kowalski is a licensed clinical psychologist with over two decades of experience treating eating disorders and body dysmorphia using evidence-based approaches including Enhanced CBT-E and Acceptance-Based Behavioral Therapy. She completed her doctorate at Northwestern University and her postdoctoral training at the renowned Renfrew Center of Excellence. She provides both individual and group-based treatment and supervises psychology trainees within the MindCare Eating Disorders Program.

name: Jordan Nakamura, LCSW
bio: Jordan Nakamura is a Licensed Clinical Social Worker with specialized training in crisis stabilization, suicide risk assessment, and acute psychiatric intervention in both emergency department and community settings. They are a certified trainer in Applied Suicide Intervention Skills Training (ASIST) and are competent in using the Columbia Suicide Severity Rating Scale (C-SSRS). Jordan is a passionate advocate for neurodivergent and nonbinary individuals within the mental health system and integrates an intersectional, anti-oppressive lens into all clinical work.
